title: Suno Raises $250M at a $2.45B Valuation (Suno, via PR Newswire)
notes: Suno primary PR, 2025-11-19. $250M Series C at $2.45B post-money; led by Menlo Ventures, participation NVentures (NVIDIA), Hallwood Media, Lightspeed, Matrix. CEO Mikey Shulman. General AI music platform, not hip-hop-specific. Hallwood = Xania Monet's label.
